plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C3, the category by the requester's rule: no library instrument checks category values against the rule, and the rule is not in the library, so this is not shown and is a known gap. (2) C5, the account reads being only for approved customers: scope of a call can be taken only during the work, not in the plan. It is priced at 10 per line, against 101 reads and an allowance of 50, so at most 5 reads can be checked. (3) C10, every sending call leaving its notice in the outbox: trace of a call can be taken only at A3 during the work, at 10 per line, so 100 sends would cost 1000 against an allowance of 50, and at most 5 can be traced. Sent as released shows only that calls were confirmed, not that outbox rows exist. (4) The live state after promotion is never read by an answer. Summary and same set read the staged set after the working copies are cleared, so the link to the live tables depends only on the promotion's line in the record. (5) The 20 units left in the plan cannot buy a trace or scope check, since neither can be named in a plan.
